# meshstack_workspace_user_binding (Data Source)

Read the one workspace user binding matching the lookup attributes you set: `metadata.name`, `target_ref.name`, `subject.name`, `role_ref.name`. Fails unless exactly one binding matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_workspace_user_binding" "example" {
  metadata = {
    name = "my-workspace-user-binding"
  }
  # or look it up by workspace, user and role:
  # target_ref = { name = "my-workspace" }
  # subject    = { name = "user@meshcloud.io" }
  # role_ref   = { name = "Workspace Member" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `role_ref` (Attributes) Workspace role assigned by this binding. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_ref))
- `subject` (Attributes) The user assigned by this binding. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject))
- `target_ref` (Attributes) Workspace to which this binding applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_ref))

### Read-Only

- `expired` (Boolean) True after the expiry date has passed.
- `expiry_date` (String) Last day the binding is effective (`YYYY-MM-DD`); null if it never expires.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Unique name of the binding. Set it to narrow the lookup.


<a id="nestedatt--role_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_ref`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the workspace role, for example `Workspace Manager` or `Workspace Member`. Set it to narrow the lookup.


<a id="nestedatt--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subject`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Username. Set it to narrow the lookup.


<a id="nestedatt--target_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_ref`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Workspace identifier. Set it to narrow the lookup.
